statement: Let C be a finite symmetric tensor category over an algebraically closed field k of characteristic p > 0. There are an integer r ≥ 1 and an embedding Er ,→ U(k) for which the construction of Section 4 gives an exact additive strong symmetric monoidal functor Φ : C −→ C ⊠ Verpr (k). It is given by Φ(X) = ΘC(X⊗pr ), where Θ is the functor in (4.1) for the chosen embedding. The functor Φ satisfies Φ(af) = apr Φ(f), and its evaluation at every projective Q ∈ C is given by the natural isomorphism (4.4).
